summary: Duhig Lane runs between and under university buildings; no kerb to park on.
reasons: Line crosses rooftops, no open road
Campus service lane, no room to stop

drivers.seclusion: Only university buildings, one at 1 m and one at 5 m; nothing residential, but in the middle of a busy campus.
drivers.access_and_room: Both images show the line over building roofs; any lane is a covered service way with no verge or pull-off.
drivers.traffic: Campus service route; loading and delivery traffic.
drivers.convention: A loading zone sign (30 mins max, at all times) sits 9 m from the line; no overnight use seen.

flags: Loading zone: 30 mins max at all times
Paid and permit car parks mapped 9-59 m away
sun_shade: Roofs and solar panels cover the line; trees shade the east end.
